cases.sql: SELECT version()
SELECT c.oid,c.relname,c.reltype,t.typarray,c.relnatts,c.relkind FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_type t ON t.oid=c.reltype WHERE c.oid IN (1417,2328,3118) ORDER BY c.oid
SELECT a.attrelid,a.attnum,a.attname,a.atttypid,a.attnotnull,a.attisdropped FROM pg_attribute a WHERE a.attrelid IN (1417,2328,3118) AND a.attnum>0 ORDER BY a.attrelid,a.attnum
CREATE FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER catalog_fdw OPTIONS (z 'last',a 'first')
CREATE SERVER catalog_source TYPE 'remote' VERSION 'v1' FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER catalog_fdw OPTIONS (z 'server-last',a 'server-first')
CREATE FOREIGN TABLE catalog_rows(id integer) SERVER catalog_source OPTIONS (z 'table-last',a 'table-first')
SELECT fdwname,pg_get_userbyid(fdwowner)=current_user AS current_owner,fdwhandler,fdwvalidator,fdwacl IS NULL AS default_acl,fdwoptions FROM pg_foreign_data_wrapper WHERE fdwname='catalog_fdw'

SELECT s.srvname,pg_get_userbyid(s.srvowner)=current_user AS current_owner,w.fdwname,s.srvtype,s.srvversion,s.srvacl IS NULL AS default_acl,s.srvoptions FROM pg_foreign_server s JOIN pg_foreign_data_wrapper w ON w.oid=s.srvfdw WHERE s.srvname='catalog_source'
SELECT c.relname,s.srvname,f.ftoptions FROM pg_foreign_table f JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=f.ftrelid JOIN pg_foreign_server s ON s.oid=f.ftserver WHERE c.relname='catalog_rows'
SELECT * FROM catalog_rows
DROP FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER catalog_fdw
DROP FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER missing_catalog_fdw
DROP FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER IF EXISTS missing_catalog_fdw
CREATE FUNCTION foreign_catalog_drop() RETURNS void LANGUAGE SQL BEGIN ATOMIC DROP FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER catalog_fdw; END
CREATE ROLE foreign_catalog_other
SET ROLE foreign_catalog_other; DROP FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER catalog_fdw CASCADE
RESET ROLE
BEGIN; DROP FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER catalog_fdw CASCADE; ROLLBACK
SELECT fdwname FROM pg_foreign_data_wrapper WHERE fdwname='catalog_fdw'
DROP ROLE foreign_catalog_other
DROP FOREIGN DATA WRAPPER catalog_fdw CASCADE

SELECT (SELECT count(*) FROM pg_foreign_data_wrapper WHERE fdwname='catalog_fdw') AS wrappers,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_foreign_server WHERE srvname='catalog_source') AS servers,(SELECT count(*) FROM pg_foreign_table f JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=f.ftrelid WHERE c.relname='catalog_rows') AS tables
